description: Figure 2 is a line plot that compares the performance of different chunking strategies on the Repos-Eval dataset. The x-axis represents the chunking strategy, with categories including "Full text," "First chunk w/ reranking," "RepoEval," and "Pre-retrieval." The y-axis represents the performance metric, with values ranging from approximately 27.4 to 31.1. The plot shows that the "Full text" strategy has the highest performance, followed by "First chunk w/ reranking," "RepoEval," and "Pre-retrieval." The plot also includes a note that the results are based on the first N tokens for N from 200 to 1500, and that most sources are best represented by the first 800 tokens except for SO posts.
